lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  apply le_antisymm ?_ real_inner_self_nonneg'
  by_contra hx
  have hp := lt_of_not_ge hx
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hcomp, hsmooth, hnonneg, hxone⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤) (hc.continuousAt.eventually_const_lt hp)
  have hφ : IsTestFunction φ := ⟨hsmooth, hcomp⟩
  have hz := hg (fun y => φ y • f x) (hφ.smul_right contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  have hn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y * ⟪f y, f x⟫_ℝ := fun y =>
    mul_nonneg_iff_pos_imp_nonneg.mpr
      ⟨fun h => (hs (subset_tsupport φ h.ne')).le, fun _ => (hnonneg ⟨y, rfl⟩).1⟩
  have hi := (hsmooth.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ) (x := x)
    hcomp.mul_right hn (by simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, hxone, one_mul, RCLike.re_to_real] using ne_of_gt hp)
  exact (ne_of_gt hi) hz
